features.feature: Terminal emulation and protocol breadth
gaps: Zmux explicitly describes its vt100 adapter as a feasibility parser, not a full engine.
No source or receipt establishes Ghostty-level escape sequence, keyboard protocol, graphics, hyperlink, shell-integration, or compatibility breadth.
acceptance: Define a protocol matrix from executable fixtures, including CSI/OSC/DCS, Unicode, alternate screen, keyboard and mouse modes, hyperlinks and graphics.
Run the same fixture corpus through both products and record intentional deviations, recovery behavior and bounded-resource results.

features.feature: Terminal rendering, styles, cursor and color
gaps: Zmux draws a bounded visible grid with basic indexed/RGB colors, bold, italic, underline and inverse; it has no evidence for shaping, ligatures, decorations beyond single underline, blink, cursor variants, transparency, damage tracking or GPU wakeup behavior.
The accepted native receipt covers ANSI color and a PNG, not visual equivalence across terminal states.
acceptance: Add golden and native pixel fixtures for wide/combining glyphs, emoji, all SGR styles, cursor modes, selection and damaged-region updates.
Measure sustained output and typing latency with no UI-thread parsing or frame backlog.

features.feature: PTY lifecycle, byte ordering and cleanup
gaps: Zmux has bounded input queues, nonblocking PTY I/O and process-group cleanup, but only local shell spawning is covered.
No parity evidence exists for login-shell environment, shell integration bootstrap, remote/mosh/tmux lifecycle or restart/reattach semantics.
acceptance: Verify ordered input/output under concurrent resize, output flood and close.
Exercise exit, crash, cancellation, launch failure and cleanup deadlines without leaked child processes or silent fallback.

features.feature: Terminal resize and kernel PTY geometry
gaps: Native smoke verifies a focused local terminal receives one split geometry; resize arbitration across hidden tabs, multiple panes/windows, rapid divider drag and remote terminals is unverified.
Zmux hard caps geometry at 120x240, which is not shown to match cmux behavior.
acceptance: Verify every live pane gets the authoritative pixel/grid size through window resize, split drag, tab switch, zoom and display scale changes.
Define overload/coalescing behavior and test rapid resize plus remote transport.

features.feature: Basic keyboard input and terminal key encoding
gaps: Zmux handles text, control letters, arrows and a small fixed special-key table; it does not implement the full Ghostty key-binding/key-table/Kitty keyboard state machine.
Function keys, keypad, modifier edge cases, layout-aware Option handling and configurable text-editing gestures lack parity evidence.
acceptance: Test physical and synthetic keyboard events across US and non-US layouts, function/keypad keys, modifier combinations, application cursor/keypad and Kitty keyboard modes.
Ensure app shortcuts, IME and terminal input have an explicit precedence contract.

features.feature: IME, marked text and dictation input
gaps: Zmux implements NSTextInputClient marked-text callbacks but the accepted receipt explicitly leaves manual IME and VoiceOver open.
Replacement ranges, candidate geometry, multi-stage composition, dictation multiline handling and shortcut bypass are not behaviorally covered.
acceptance: Dogfood Japanese, Chinese and Korean composition plus dictation in live PTYs.
Add behavioral tests for marked-text selection, replacement ranges, candidate placement and no premature terminal bytes.

features.feature: Mouse reporting, pointer focus and alternate-screen wheel routing
gaps: Zmux verifies wheel reports for legacy/UTF-8/SGR modes and alternate-screen arrows, but no terminal mouse button, motion, drag, hover or focus-report protocol is implemented.
Shift is used as a history override without evidence that all cmux modifier policies match.
acceptance: Implement and test press/release/motion/drag/focus events for supported encodings and modifiers.
Verify terminal mouse capture does not break native selection, context menus, focus activation or split dragging.

features.feature: Scrollback retention and history navigation
gaps: Zmux bounds history at 1,000 lines and verifies wheel/Home/End behavior plus return-to-live on input.
There is no configurable byte/line budget, smooth/pixel scrolling, scroll speed policy, persisted/checkpointed scrollback or copy-mode history parity.
acceptance: Specify and measure line/byte budgets, eviction and output-while-anchored behavior.
Verify precise trackpad, page/top/bottom, alternate screen, hidden tabs and restored sessions.

features.feature: Pointer selection and clipboard copy
gaps: Zmux selects only the visible grid with a simple rectangular range and copies reconstructed rendered runs.
Word/line selection, wrapped lines, scrollback selection, drag autoscroll, wide/combining glyph offsets, copy-on-select and rich selection semantics are absent or unverified.
acceptance: Cover character, word, line and rectangular selection across wrapped lines and scrollback.
Verify exact copied text for Unicode, trailing spaces and multi-line joins through mouse, menu and shortcut entrypoints.

features.feature: Keyboard copy mode
gaps: No zmux copy-mode state, cursor, selection movement, search or indicator exists.
Cmux has native terminal copy mode, but its tmux-compatible `copy-mode` CLI deliberately returns an unsupported error; that placeholder is not evidence of a CLI entrypoint for native copy mode.
acceptance: Expose native copy mode through its supported menu and shortcut actions, with any future CLI contract specified separately.
Test enter/exit, cursor motion, selection types, scrollback movement, copy and focus/tab transitions.
Preserve an honest unsupported result for a compatibility placeholder until a real CLI behavior is defined.

features.feature: Text paste and bracketed-paste semantics
gaps: Zmux reads plain text synchronously and wraps bracketed paste; it has no confirmation, plain-text/one-line variants, deferred input sequencing or large-paste policy.
Clipboard interaction is not in the accepted native smoke evidence.
acceptance: Test normal, bracketed, multiline, oversized and empty pastes plus input ordering while paste preparation is pending.
Provide Paste, Paste as Plain Text and Paste as One Line with consistent menu/shortcut/CLI errors.

features.feature: File, image and screenshot paste/upload
gaps: Zmux accepts only clipboard strings; it does not save/upload image or file clipboard payloads, paste the resulting path, route remote targets or report transfer failure.
Paste Last Screenshot is absent.
acceptance: Support local and remote file/image paste with bounded size, lifetime cleanup, cancellation and explicit failure.
Verify the path is inserted into the initiating live surface only, never a later selected tab.

features.feature: Terminal drag and drop
gaps: TerminalView registers no external pasteboard types and has no file/folder/URL drop route.
acceptance: Route local files, directories, images and supported URLs to the intended terminal with correct quoting or upload semantics.
Reject stale/cross-window targets and surface visible errors.

features.feature: Inline terminal images and graphics protocols
gaps: The zmux parser/view exposes only text runs; no Kitty graphics, Sixel, iTerm image or placement lifecycle is represented.
acceptance: Render supported image protocols with bounded decode/memory and correct scroll/resize/clear behavior.
Test malformed, oversized and concurrent image streams.

features.feature: Terminal find, next/previous, hide and use-selection-for-find
gaps: Zmux has no terminal search state, overlay, match counts, focus restore or selection-seeded find.
acceptance: Search visible and retained scrollback with incremental match counts and next/previous navigation.
Verify menu, shortcuts and focus restoration across pane/tab/window changes.

features.feature: Clear screen while retaining scrollback
gaps: No distinct clear-screen-keep-history action exists; sending escape sequences is not an equivalent app action.
acceptance: Implement through the terminal owner and preserve retained history while resetting the live viewport as specified.
Verify shortcut/menu/CLI parity and alternate-screen behavior.

features.feature: Terminal links and selection context actions
gaps: Zmux terminal has no context menu for open link in embedded/default browser, copy link, Reveal in Finder or Translate selection.
acceptance: Resolve links under pointer without corrupting selection and expose correct enabled states.
Prevent remote paths from being treated as local Finder paths.

features.feature: Shell title and working-directory integration
gaps: Zmux parses title and OSC 7 cwd and uses cwd for fresh-shell restore.
No evidence covers hostname trust, remote cwd, title stacks, shell integration install/bootstrap, tab-title precedence or cwd changes during restore races.
acceptance: Test local/remote OSC variants, invalid values and title/cwd precedence.
Verify restored cwd is explicit and failure remains retryable rather than silently using HOME.

features.feature: Terminal font zoom, theme and appearance customization
gaps: Zmux hardcodes one font, size and palette; it has no workspace font zoom/reset, configurable themes, ligatures, opacity/background or persistence.
acceptance: Expose appearance through shared settings and apply without restarting sessions.
Verify zoom scope, grid resize, persistence and accessible contrast.

features.feature: Terminal accessibility text interface
gaps: Zmux publishes role, label and a visible contents value, but lacks character counts/ranges, lines, selected text/range, set-value input and explicit selector policy.
Native smoke checks the value only; VoiceOver remains open.
acceptance: Expose stable visible text, ranges, selection and insertion semantics through NSAccessibility.
Complete manual VoiceOver and dictation journeys while scrolling, selecting and switching tabs.

features.feature: Terminal failures, overload and recovery presentation
gaps: Zmux has descriptive queue/size/closed/busy errors and renders a simple state string, but no user action for retry/reconnect/copy diagnostics.
Control-string overflow permanently fails the parser with no tested surface recovery flow.
acceptance: Present launch, parser, queue, transport and cleanup failures with retry or explicit terminal state.
Verify no success-shaped UI after rejected/unknown-outcome mutations and no silent event loss.

features.feature: Exited terminal remains inspectable
gaps: Zmux preserves a final terminal snapshot after process exit, but restart/respawn, close confirmation and remote-disconnect distinctions are absent.
acceptance: Keep final output and exit status visible, with explicit restart/close behavior.
Distinguish local exit, parser failure, remote disconnect and killed-on-close.

features.feature: Terminal input ownership and ordering during asynchronous work
gaps: The PTY worker preserves queued byte order, but zmux has no higher-level sequencing for clipboard preparation, deferred native events, file uploads or surface replacement.
acceptance: Define one ordered input lane for keyboard, IME, paste, mouse reports and automation.
Test close/move/reattach while asynchronous paste or upload is pending.

features.feature: Alternate-screen isolation
gaps: Zmux separates alternate-screen scroll behavior and reports the mode, but selection, clipboard, resize, clear, search and restore behavior across mode transitions is unverified.
acceptance: Test entry/exit restoration, scroll routing, selection/search isolation, resize and malformed mode sequences.

features.feature: Tmux-compatible terminal capture, history, buffers, piping and respawn
gaps: Zmux can read one bounded visible screen and send bounded text, but has no scrollback-aware capture-pane contract, clear-history action, named buffer store, pipe-to-command path, pane respawn owner or display-message compatibility command.
The existing pane-oriented read/send commands do not provide cmux surface/window selectors, exact buffer bytes, bracketed paste routing, shell exit reporting or respawn safety semantics.
acceptance: Specify capture bounds, surface targeting and clear-history effects independently from visible-screen reads.
Bound and persist named buffers as required, preserve exact bytes, distinguish bracketed paste from keystrokes and reject missing/stale targets.
Define command-execution policy, timeout, exit and stderr behavior for piping; respawn must not duplicate a live process or hide a failed replacement.

features.feature: Independent terminal tabs in a pane
gaps: Zmux verifies that Command-T creates a sibling surface with an independent PTY and does not split.
Per-tab pinning, manual unread, advanced kinds, cross-window identity and cmux targeting semantics remain open.
acceptance: Retain independent live sessions across select, reorder, hide, split, move and workspace/window transitions.
Reconcile UX-ACTION-079 and CMD-067 option/target contracts.

features.feature: Tab selection, cycling and numbered selection
gaps: Click/accessibility selection and next/previous menu actions exist; numbered selection and configurable next/previous behavior are absent.
No wrap, disabled-state or multiwindow target parity evidence exists.
acceptance: Implement next, previous and by-number through one owner with documented wrap and focus behavior.
Verify hidden tabs, browser/terminal mixtures and invalid targets.

features.feature: Tab rename and title precedence
gaps: Zmux exposes rename through context menu and a validated Rust action, but has no test of manual title versus shell/browser title updates or empty-name reset.
acceptance: Specify manual, shell and browser title precedence and clearing behavior.
Verify menu, shortcut and CLI use the same validation/error path.

features.feature: Tab reorder and live-session preserving move
gaps: Rust tests cover reorder and cross-pane/workspace move without restarting the session; native drag only reorders within one tab strip.
Directional move shortcuts, drag between panes/windows, drop overlays and rollback UX are absent.
acceptance: Exercise mouse and keyboard moves within/between panes, workspaces and windows while preserving identity, process and focus.
Reject stale/foreign/capacity-invalid drops atomically.

features.feature: Close one tab and preserve siblings
gaps: Command-W and Rust tests preserve sibling processes, but cmux close warnings, pinned/protected/remote semantics and close failure presentation are not matched.
acceptance: Verify shortcut, menu, context button and CLI share confirmation and effect ownership.
Cover last tab/pane/workspace/window plus protected and remote sessions.

features.feature: Close other tabs as one confirmed batch
gaps: Zmux native context menu confirms, and the Rust owner records one grouped history item.
Pinned/remote safety filtering, cancellation assertions and command shortcut parity are not covered by current tests/receipt.
acceptance: Test confirm and cancel with mixed terminal/browser and protected tabs.
Ensure one history record and no partial close on rejection/failure.

features.feature: Recently closed history and selected-item reopen
gaps: Zmux supports bounded in-process history, last reopen and selected menu/CLI reopen.
It stores count only, not age/bytes, and lacks persisted window records, privacy clearing and cross-launch behavior.
acceptance: Define count, byte and age bounds plus clear/privacy policy.
Verify mixed tab/pane/workspace/window order and unavailable descriptors.

features.feature: Retryable close-history restoration
gaps: Zmux consumes history only after successful PTY launch and rolls back grouped provisional sessions on failure.
Browser profile, remote reattach, window restore and user-facing retry/error banners are absent.
acceptance: Keep failed entries retriable with visible cause and prevent double restore.
Cover late completion, close-during-restore and mixed surface kinds.

features.feature: Closed pane/workspace grouped layout restore
gaps: Zmux restores a closed workspace tree and grouped tabs with fresh identities; a closed pane intentionally restores in a new workspace because no live split anchor is stored.
Exact original pane placement, ratios, canvas geometry and window association are incomplete.
acceptance: Capture and restore anchors, split ratios/order, selected tabs and focus with deterministic fallback.
Test renamed/moved neighbors and missing original containers.

features.feature: Fresh-shell semantics for reopened local terminals
gaps: Zmux correctly creates a new PTY/session ID from saved cwd/title and does not replay input.
It cannot reattach eligible live tmux/remote sessions and has no explicit UX explaining fresh-shell restoration.
acceptance: Keep local reopen non-replaying and expose fresh-process semantics.
Only reattach remote/tmux sessions after verified identity and availability.

features.feature: Workspace create, select and rename
gaps: Zmux can create, click-select via pane focus and rename numeric-ID workspaces.
Numbered selection, go-to-workspace UI, configured creation kinds/default layout and cmux new-workspace versus new-surface semantics are incomplete.
acceptance: Unify menu/shortcut/sidebar/CLI workspace targeting and naming.
Test numbered selection, limits, invalid names and focus restoration.

features.feature: Workspace reorder, pinning, metadata and status
gaps: Zmux workspace model has only id, name, focused pane and tree; there is no reorder, pin tier, description, color, todo/status or multi-select.
acceptance: Add explicit workspace metadata and ordering owners with persisted invariants.
Expose menu/context/shortcut/CLI paths and verify multi-selection and pinned close gates.

features.feature: Workspace groups
gaps: No group model, anchor, collapse, pin, reorder, empty-group or group-aware navigation exists.
acceptance: Implement create/group/ungroup/rename/collapse/pin/reorder with contiguous ordering invariants.
Verify group-aware next/previous, selection, persistence and close/reopen.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: workspace-group
source_catalog_namespaces.note: The source and docs keep the hyphenated top-level form as a supported alias; advertised RPC declarations are discovery evidence, not runtime parity.

features.feature: Pane split creation and collapse
gaps: Zmux creates horizontal/vertical splits, focuses the new pane and collapses empty branches while preserving survivors.
Directional placement naming, split-off-current-tab, browser split, automatic layout and cmux config defaults are incomplete.
acceptance: Verify right/down placement, split-off and new-pane semantics for terminal/browser tabs.
Preserve geometry and PTY sizing through nested close/collapse.

features.feature: Directional, previous/next and numbered pane focus
gaps: Zmux can focus a known pane ID or click a terminal, but has no geometry-based direction, previous/next order or numbered pane action.
acceptance: Define pane order and directional neighbor resolution for nested splits.
Route shortcut, command palette and CLI through the same focus mutation and error path.

features.feature: Pane divider resize and retained ratios
gaps: Zmux native drag/keyboard-accessible splitter retains a ratio across tab changes in one live process, but ratios are native-view cache state rather than Rust topology/persistence.
Directional pane-resize shortcuts and CLI resize are absent.
acceptance: Move geometry ownership into shared state and persist it.
Verify mouse, accessibility, shortcut and CLI resize with min sizes, nested splits and PTY updates.

features.feature: Equalize splits, pane zoom and automatic layout
gaps: Zmux can set one divider fraction but has no equalize, focused-pane zoom/unzoom or automatic new-pane layout action/state.
acceptance: Implement reversible zoom with prior layout retention and focus-safe equalization.
Test nested splits, close while zoomed, resize and restored geometry.

features.feature: Focus history back, forward, last and recently focused
gaps: Zmux stores only current workspace/pane/surface focus and no navigation history.
acceptance: Record bounded window/workspace/pane/surface history with stale-target pruning.
Verify back/forward/last and selected recent item after close, move and restore.

features.feature: Multiwindow lifecycle and action routing
gaps: Zmux owns one NSWindow/AppController and has no shared window model, new/close window action, per-window active routing or window identity.
acceptance: Model multiple windows with stable IDs and route menus/shortcuts/CLI to explicit or active targets.
Test last-window policy, activation, close confirmation and independent focus histories.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: window
source_catalog_namespaces.note: The namespace dispatcher covers display placement and an offline DEBUG default-display setting; create, focus, close, list and current remain separate top-level verbs/RPC methods, so the namespace name alone does not prove lifecycle coverage.

features.feature: Move workspaces/tabs between windows and split off
gaps: Cross-pane action code cannot target another window because zmux has no window owner; move-to-new-workspace and move-workspace-to-window are absent.
acceptance: Preserve the live surface/session while moving between workspace/window containers.
Collapse old containers, transfer focus/history/accessibility and reject stale destinations atomically.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: detach-tab
source_catalog_namespaces.note: Both spellings dispatch to the same owner; the original command ledger already tracks the canonical form.

features.feature: Full screen, hide/show all windows and window hints
gaps: No cmux-equivalent actions or hint overlay exist in zmux menus or shared model.
acceptance: Expose native full-screen and show/hide semantics with correct focused-window restoration.
Implement hint mode with keyboard capture, cancellation and accessibility.

features.feature: Canvas layout, overview, zoom, tidy, align and distribute
gaps: Zmux variable named canvas is only the normal split host; there is no canvas mode or pane geometry/action model.
acceptance: Implement toggle, reveal, overview, zoom, tidy, alignment, equalization and distribution through shared actions.
Persist z-order/frames and verify focus, hit testing, resize and recovery.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: canvas
source_catalog_namespaces.note: The supplied command ledger had no canvas command row; UI action IDs cover the visible behavior family, while RPC declarations only establish discovery.

features.feature: Saved/custom layout templates
gaps: Zmux has an in-memory binary split tree only; no named template capture, validation, apply or error path exists.
acceptance: Capture supported topology/geometry independently from live processes.
Validate and apply templates atomically with explicit fallback for unavailable surface kinds.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: layout
source_catalog_namespaces.note: The original command ledger omitted the local saved-layout namespace; CMD-359 is vm layout and is adjacent, not an alias for cmux layout.

features.feature: Session save, open and previous-launch restore
gaps: Zmux does not serialize workspace/window/pane/surface state; only sidebarCollapsed is stored in UserDefaults.
Undo-close is in-process and must not be counted as session persistence or crash recovery.
acceptance: Add versioned, bounded, atomic persistence for windows, workspaces, pane trees, ratios, surfaces and supported restore descriptors.
Separate named session open/save, previous clean launch, crash recovery and undo-close behaviors.

source_catalog_namespaces.name: surface-resume
source_catalog_namespaces.note: This alias stores, reads or clears restart metadata; it does not itself perform session or crash restoration, and the original command ledger has no direct surface-resume row.

features.feature: Topology capacities, atomic rejection and stable identifiers
gaps: Zmux bounds workspaces, panes, depth, tabs and close history and applies actions transactionally.
Numeric process-local IDs do not satisfy cmux UUID/typed-reference/caller-default contracts, and byte/age/memory budgets remain incomplete.
acceptance: Document every count/byte/time budget and expose deterministic capacity errors.
Adopt typed stable references across CLI/UI/persistence without ID theft on restore.

features.feature: Tmux-compatible synchronization, pane movement, navigation and hooks
gaps: Zmux exposes basic focus, split and move primitives but no wait-for token, pane swap/break/join compatibility contract, previous/next/last compatibility navigation, find-window selector or persisted hook definition owner.

Cmux deliberately rejects popup, bind-key, unbind-key and CLI copy-mode as unsupported placeholders. Those errors are part of the observed compatibility contract; native terminal copy mode is a separate feature in TERM-010.
acceptance: Route implemented topology verbs through the same stable-ID, focus and atomic-mutation owners as native actions.
Make wait/signal bounded and race-safe; make hook storage and execution lifecycle explicit, including command-execution policy.
For deliberate placeholders, return clear nonzero unsupported errors and do not advertise successful behavior.

features.feature: Current work, topology, resource and surface-health inspection
gaps: Zmux reports app counts and can list workspace/pane models plus one visible terminal screen, but it has no app-wide bounded current-work facts, complete window/workspace/pane/surface tree, attributed CPU/RSS/process view, app-versus-child memory diagnosis or surface-health inventory.
Numeric process-local IDs, one-window ownership and missing freshness/evidence fields prevent cmux-compatible inspection output.
acceptance: Expose stable, bounded, read-only snapshots for current, tree, top, memory and surface health without changing focus or refreshing remote state implicitly.
Distinguish unknown, stale, unavailable and failed observations; preserve stable IDs and documented JSON/text schemas.
Attribute app/WebKit/terminal child resources without double counting and verify output under exited, launching, hidden and overloaded surfaces.

features.feature: Main menu command coverage
gaps: Zmux has small app/workspace/history/browser/edit menus; it lacks most File/View/Window/History terminal and topology actions present in cmux.
Menu presence alone does not prove shared action parity or enabled-state correctness.
acceptance: Inventory every cmux menu row in this audit scope and map it to a shared action or explicit supported divergence.
Test titles, key equivalents, enabled state, target window and errors.

features.feature: Terminal tab and workspace context menus
gaps: Zmux tab menu has Rename/Close/Close Others and workspace menu has Rename/Close only.
Pin/unpin, unread, IDs/links, move destinations, grouping, order, close ranges, Finder/link/translate, reconnect/disconnect and other context actions are absent.
acceptance: Build context menus from current shared state at open time with correct hidden/disabled reasons.
Verify every action reaches the same owner as its menu/shortcut/CLI peer.

features.feature: Configurable shortcuts, chords and when clauses
gaps: Zmux has fixed NSMenu key equivalents only; no action registry, customization, unbinding, chords, when clauses, conflict detection or settings UI exists.
This contract applies across the 171-row UI action ledger; UX-ACTION-001 and UX-ACTION-171 are ordinary endpoint actions, not semantic identifiers for shortcut configuration.
acceptance: Create one action registry used by menus, settings, palette and event routing.
Test chord lifecycle, focus contexts, terminal alternate-screen predicates, IME bypass, disabled actions and conflicting bindings.

features.feature: Command palette for terminal and topology actions
gaps: No command palette, search/discovery model, disabled reason or focus-restoration coordinator exists.
acceptance: Expose scoped actions and current disabled reasons through the same registry as menus/shortcuts.
Verify keyboard navigation, IME, submit/cancel and prior first-responder restoration.

features.feature: Menu validation and failure feedback
gaps: Zmux validates a small selector set and disables restoring history entries, but most invalid shared actions only update a status string/last_error.
No parity exists for close-confirmation modal routing, focused-kind enablement or explicit beep/banner behavior.
acceptance: Derive enabled state from the same preconditions as execution.
Surface rejection and unknown outcome without mutating focus or showing success.

features.feature: Workspace row accessibility and keyboard navigation
gaps: Zmux rows are accessible buttons with label/selected state, but no evidence covers keyboard traversal, group hierarchy, actions, reorder announcements or VoiceOver selection/focus.
acceptance: Expose ordered rows/groups, selection, status and available actions without duplicate decorative nodes.
Dogfood full keyboard and VoiceOver workspace switching/reordering.

features.feature: Tab bar accessibility and keyboard operation
gaps: Zmux tabs expose button role, label, selected state, press action and Enter/Space selection, but the accepted receipt does not include VoiceOver or tab-strip keyboard traversal.
Reorder and context actions have no accessibility action contract.
acceptance: Verify VoiceOver names, values, selected state, close controls and focus order for mixed terminal/browser tabs.
Support accessible reorder/move and announce attention without changing the title text contract.

features.feature: Accessible splitters
gaps: Zmux exposes splitter role, label, percentage and increment/decrement, but no native accessibility receipt or persisted geometry owner exists.
acceptance: Verify VoiceOver adjustment, keyboard arrows, min/max values and PTY resize in nested layouts.
Persist the resulting shared geometry.

features.feature: Drag UX across tab strips, panes, workspaces and windows
gaps: Zmux supports in-app drag only onto the source pane's tab bar for reorder.
There are no pane-edge split targets, other-pane/workspace/window destinations, drag previews, autoscroll, cancellation recovery or external payload arbitration.
acceptance: Implement typed drag payloads with live ownership validation and visible destination overlays.
Test reorder, move, split, cross-window, cancellation and stale-source cleanup.

features.feature: Localization of terminal and topology UI
gaps: Zmux native strings are bare English literals and no localization catalog is present for these surfaces.
acceptance: Move every user-facing menu, dialog, tooltip, accessibility and error string to a localization catalog.
Audit all supported locales and preserve placeholders/plurals.
